server_scripts.script:
# LuCrusher – Tool Fetch Lucidchart Document  (bpmn_id: fetch_lucidchart_document)
# Self-contained (split globals/locals — see the patch docstring). Returns a
# TRIMMED document to the LLM and stashes the FULL parse in the turn store, so
# the model never has to re-serialise a 100 kB document and the frontend still
# receives every shape.
from one_bpmn.agents.turn_state import update_turn

def _lucrusher_fetch_lucidchart(frappe, document_id_or_url):
    import re
    import time

    _API_NAME = "Lucidchart"
    _BASE_URL = "https://api.lucid.co"
    _CONTENT_MAX_RETRIES = 1
    _CONTENT_RETRY_BASE_DELAY = 2

    _UUID_PATTERN = r"[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}"
    _URL_RE = re.compile(
        r"https?://(?:lucid\.app|app\.lucidchart\.com)"
        r"(?:/lucidchart)?(?:/documents?)?"
        r"(?:/(?:edit|view|invitations/accept))?"
        r"/(" + _UUID_PATTERN + r")"
        r"(?:[/?#].*)?$",
        re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    _UUID_RE = re.compile(r"^" + _UUID_PATTERN + r"$", re.IGNORECASE)

    # Lucid reports PascalCase "…Block" class names on the Contents API and
    # keyword-ish names elsewhere; the class is lower-cased before matching and
    # longer/more specific entries come first so the first hit wins. The Lucid
    # BPMN library entries matter most: without them every activity, gateway
    # and event falls through to "Shape" and a real process map summarises as
    # zero steps and zero decisions.
    _SHAPE_CLASS_MAP = [
        ("bpmntextannotation", "Text Annotation"),
        ("bpmnactivity", "Process Step"),
        ("bpmngateway", "Decision/Gateway"),
        ("bpmnevent", "Start/End Event"),
        ("processblock", "Process Step"),
        ("terminatorblock", "Start/End"),
        ("decisionblock", "Decision/Gateway"),
        ("swimlanecontainerblock", "Pool/Swimlane"),
        ("poolcontainerblock", "Pool/Swimlane"),
        ("laneblock", "Lane"),
        ("defaultsquareblock", "Process Step"),
        ("defaultroundedblock", "Process Step"),
        ("defaultdiamondblock", "Decision/Gateway"),
        ("defaultcircleblock", "Start/End Event"),
        ("annotationblock", "Text Annotation"),
        ("noteblock", "Text Annotation"),
        ("textblock", "Text Box"),
        ("parallelogramblock", "Input/Output"),
        ("cylinderblock", "Data Store"),
        ("databaseblock", "Data Store"),
        ("documentblock", "Document"),
        ("manualoperationblock", "Manual Operation"),
        ("delayblock", "Delay"),
        ("starteventblock", "Start Event"),
        ("endeventblock", "End Event"),
        ("intermediateblock", "Intermediate Event"),
        ("taskblock", "Task"),
        ("usertaskblock", "User Task"),
        ("servicetaskblock", "Service Task"),
        ("scripttaskblock", "Script Task"),
        ("exclusivegatewayblock", "Decision/Gateway"),
        ("inclusivegatewayblock", "OR Gateway"),
        ("parallelgatewayblock", "Parallel Gateway"),
        ("eventbasedgatewayblock", "Event-Based Gateway"),
        ("decision", "Decision/Gateway"),
        ("diamond", "Decision/Gateway"),
        ("terminator", "Start/End"),
        ("start", "Start Event"),
        ("end", "End Event"),
        ("swimlane", "Swimlane"),
        ("pool", "Pool/Swimlane"),
        ("lane", "Lane"),
        ("annotation", "Text Annotation"),
        ("note", "Text Annotation"),
        ("text", "Text Box"),
        ("process", "Process Step"),
        ("rectangle", "Process Step"),
        ("roundrect", "Process Step"),
        ("parallelogram", "Input/Output"),
        ("cylinder", "Data Store"),
        ("database", "Data Store"),
        ("document", "Document"),
        ("manual", "Manual Operation"),
        ("delay", "Delay"),
        ("loop", "Loop"),
        ("or", "OR Gateway"),
        ("xor", "XOR Gateway"),
        ("and", "AND Gateway"),
        ("parallel", "Parallel Gateway"),
        ("circle", "Event"),
        ("oval", "Start/End Event"),
    ]

    def _classify_shape(shape):
        raw = (shape.get("class") or shape.get("type") or shape.get("shapeType") or "").lower()
        for keyword, label in _SHAPE_CLASS_MAP:
            if keyword in raw:
                return label
        return "Shape"

    def _get_text(shape):
        # Contents API exposes textAreas; other formats a string/dict/list.
        text_areas = shape.get("textAreas")
        if text_areas and isinstance(text_areas, list):
            for ta in text_areas:
                if isinstance(ta, dict):
                    raw = (ta.get("text") or ta.get("value") or "").strip()
                    if raw:
                        raw = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", raw).strip()
                        return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", raw)
            return ""
        text = shape.get("text") or shape.get("label") or ""
        if isinstance(text, dict):
            text = text.get("plainText") or text.get("html") or ""
        elif isinstance(text, list):
            parts = []
            for node in text:
                if isinstance(node, dict):
                    parts.append(node.get("text") or "")
                elif isinstance(node, str):
                    parts.append(node)
            text = " ".join([p for p in parts if p])
        text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", str(text)).strip()
        return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)

    def _walk_shapes(shapes, depth=0):
        # Follows swimlane containers into their children so tasks nested in a
        # lane row are captured too.
        out = []
        for shape in shapes or []:
            children = shape.get("children") or shape.get("childShapes") or shape.get("cells") or []
            if not children:
                inner = shape.get("items")
                if isinstance(inner, list):
                    children = inner
                elif isinstance(inner, dict):
                    children = inner.get("shapes") or []
            out.append({
                "id": shape.get("id") or shape.get("ItemId") or "",
                "type": _classify_shape(shape),
                "text": _get_text(shape),
                "children_count": len(children),
                "depth": depth,
            })
            if children:
                out.extend(_walk_shapes(children, depth + 1))
        return out

    def _parse_lines(lines):
        out = []
        for line in lines or []:
            ep1 = line.get("endpoint1") or line.get("source") or {}
            ep2 = line.get("endpoint2") or line.get("target") or {}
            out.append({
                "id": line.get("id") or line.get("ItemId") or "",
                "from": ep1.get("connectedTo") or ep1.get("shapeId") or ep1.get("id") or ep1.get("cell") or "",
                "to": ep2.get("connectedTo") or ep2.get("shapeId") or ep2.get("id") or ep2.get("cell") or "",
                "label": _get_text(line),
            })
        return out

    def _summarise_page(page_data):
        page_id = page_data.get("id") or page_data.get("pageId") or ""
        page_title = page_data.get("title") or page_data.get("name") or "Untitled Page"

        items_container = page_data.get("items")
        if items_container is not None:
            if isinstance(items_container, dict):
                raw_shapes = list(items_container.get("shapes") or [])
                raw_lines = list(items_container.get("lines") or [])
            elif isinstance(items_container, list):
                # Flat mixed array — only lines carry endpoint1/endpoint2.
                raw_shapes = [x for x in items_container if not (x.get("endpoint1") or x.get("endpoint2"))]
                raw_lines = [x for x in items_container if (x.get("endpoint1") or x.get("endpoint2"))]
            else:
                raw_shapes = []
                raw_lines = []
        else:
            raw_shapes = list(
                page_data.get("shapes")
                or page_data.get("allShapes")
                or page_data.get("children")
                or page_data.get("cells")
                or []
            )
            raw_lines = list(
                page_data.get("lines") or page_data.get("edges") or page_data.get("connections") or []
            )

        # Multi-layer documents nest items under page.layers[i].items.
        if not raw_shapes and not raw_lines:
            for layer in (page_data.get("layers") or []):
                layer_items = layer.get("items")
                if isinstance(layer_items, list):
                    for x in layer_items:
                        if x.get("endpoint1") or x.get("endpoint2"):
                            raw_lines.append(x)
                        else:
                            raw_shapes.append(x)
                elif isinstance(layer_items, dict):
                    raw_shapes.extend(layer_items.get("shapes") or [])
                    raw_lines.extend(layer_items.get("lines") or [])

        shapes = _walk_shapes(raw_shapes)
        lines = _parse_lines(raw_lines)

        swimlanes = [s for s in shapes if "Swimlane" in s["type"] or "Pool" in s["type"] or "Lane" in s["type"]]
        process_steps = [
            s for s in shapes
            if s["type"] in ("Process Step", "Input/Output", "Document", "Manual Operation") and s["text"]
        ]
        decisions = [s for s in shapes if "Decision" in s["type"] or "Gateway" in s["type"] and s["text"]]
        terminators = [s for s in shapes if "Start" in s["type"] or "End" in s["type"]]
        annotations = [s for s in shapes if "Annotation" in s["type"] or "Text Box" in s["type"] and s["text"]]

        return {
            "page_id": page_id,
            "page_title": page_title,
            "shape_count": len(shapes),
            "line_count": len(lines),
            "swimlanes": [{"id": s["id"], "text": s["text"]} for s in swimlanes],
            "process_steps": [{"id": s["id"], "text": s["text"]} for s in process_steps],
            "decisions": [{"id": s["id"], "text": s["text"]} for s in decisions],
            "terminators": [{"id": s["id"], "text": s["text"]} for s in terminators],
            "annotations": [{"id": s["id"], "text": s["text"]} for s in annotations],
            "connections": lines,
            "raw_shapes": shapes,
        }

    def _credentials():
        extra_headers = {}
        try:
            if frappe.db.exists("API Integration", _API_NAME):
                doc = frappe.get_doc("API Integration", _API_NAME)
                if not doc.active:
                    # Not fatal — an admin may be testing with the flag off.
                    frappe.log_error(
                        title="LuCrusher — Lucidchart not active",
                        message="API Integration record '" + _API_NAME + "' exists but is not active.",
                    )
                api_key = doc.get_password("api_key") or ""
                burl = (doc.url or _BASE_URL).rstrip("/")
                for row in (doc.api_parameter or []):
                    if row.header and row.parameter and row.value:
                        extra_headers[row.parameter] = row.get_password("value") or row.value
                if api_key:
                    return api_key, burl, extra_headers
        except Exception:
            frappe.log_error(
                title="LuCrusher — Lucidchart credentials (DocType)",
                message=frappe.get_traceback(),
            )
        api_key = frappe.conf.get("lucidchart_api_key") or ""
        burl = (frappe.conf.get("lucidchart_base_url") or _BASE_URL).rstrip("/")
        if api_key:
            return api_key, burl, extra_headers
        return None, _BASE_URL, extra_headers

    def _auth_headers(api_key, extra_headers):
        headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Accept": "application/json",
            "Lucid-Api-Version": "1",
        }
        if api_key:
            headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer " + api_key
        headers.update(extra_headers)
        return headers

    def _parse_document_id(input_str):
        text = (input_str or "").strip()
        if not text:
            return None
        m = _URL_RE.search(text)
        if m:
            return m.group(1).lower()
        if _UUID_RE.match(text):
            return text.lower()
        return None

    def _fail(document_id, error):
        return {
            "document_id": document_id,
            "title": "",
            "pages": [],
            "page_count": 0,
            "total_shapes": 0,
            "total_lines": 0,
            "summary": "",
            "error": error,
        }

    def _fetch_content(document_id, base_url, headers):
        # The Contents API has no pagination and often 500s or times out on very
        # large documents; a 500 or an unreachable host is retried with
        # exponential backoff. Returns (data, http_status) so the summary can
        # name the exact failure — 0 means "no response at all".
        content_url = base_url + "/v1/documents/" + document_id + "/contents"
        last_status = 0
        for attempt in range(_CONTENT_MAX_RETRIES + 1):
            try:
                data = frappe.integrations.utils.make_get_request(content_url, headers=headers)
                if isinstance(data, dict):
                    return data, 200
                frappe.log_error(
                    title="LuCrusher — Lucidchart content not JSON",
                    message="document_id=" + repr(document_id) + "\nGot: " + str(data)[:1000],
                )
                return None, 200
            except Exception as exc:
                resp = frappe.flags.integration_request
                last_status = resp.status_code if resp is not None else 0
                body = resp.text[:500] if resp is not None else ""
                retryable = last_status in (500, 0)
                if retryable and attempt < _CONTENT_MAX_RETRIES:
                    delay = _CONTENT_RETRY_BASE_DELAY * (2 ** attempt)
                    frappe.log_error(
                        title="LuCrusher — Lucidchart content " + str(last_status) + ", retrying",
                        message=(
                            "document_id=" + repr(document_id)
                            + "  attempt=" + str(attempt + 1)
                            + "  retry_delay=" + str(delay) + "s\n"
                            + "Body (first 500): " + body
                        ),
                    )
                    time.sleep(delay)
                    continue
                frappe.log_error(
                    title="LuCrusher — Lucidchart content fetch failed",
                    message=(
                        "document_id=" + repr(document_id) + "\nURL: " + content_url
                        + "\nStatus: " + str(last_status) + "\nError: " + str(exc)
                        + "\nBody: " + body
                    ),
                )
                return None, last_status
        return None, last_status

    def _build_summary(title, document_id, pages, content_status):
        lines = []
        doc_label = '"' + title + '"' if title else "document " + str(document_id)
        lines.append("I've successfully read the Lucidchart document " + doc_label + ".")
        lines.append("It contains " + str(len(pages)) + " page(s).")

        all_empty = True
        for p in pages:
            if p.get("shape_count", 0) != 0:
                all_empty = False
                break
        is_large_doc = all_empty and len(pages) > 0 and content_status in (500, 0)

        if is_large_doc:
            # Page titles only. Reported as the partial read it is: the previous
            # wording called this a success and invited the agent to analyse the
            # topology from page names, which produced a confident split of a
            # 23-page document that nobody had read.
            lines = []
            lines.append(
                "I reached the Lucidchart document " + doc_label + " and can see it has "
                + str(len(pages)) + " page(s), but Lucidchart's content API did not return the "
                "shapes, so I have NOT read what is on those pages."
            )
            lines.append("")
            lines.append("**Page names only:**")
            i = 0
            for page in pages:
                i += 1
                lines.append("  " + str(i) + ". " + (page.get("page_title") or ("Page " + str(i))))
            lines.append("")
            lines.append(
                "Page names are not enough to split a document into processes — say so rather "
                "than proposing a topology from them. Ask to try the fetch again ('#refresh'), "
                "or for one page at a time ('<document_id>#page=<n>'), or ask the user which "
                "pages cover which stage."
            )
            return "\n".join(lines)

        if content_status == 403:
            content_hint = (
                "  ⚠ HTTP 403 — the API key does not have the "
                "'lucidchart.document.content:readonly' scope.  "
                "Go to the Lucidchart Developer Portal → your OAuth app → Scopes "
                "and add 'lucidchart.document.content:readonly', then regenerate "
                "the API key. Ask the platform admin to do this; a process owner cannot change it."
            )
        elif content_status == 402:
            content_hint = (
                "  ⚠ HTTP 402 — the Lucidchart plan on this account does not "
                "include API access to document content.  "
                "An Enterprise or Team plan with API enabled is required."
            )
        elif content_status == 404:
            content_hint = (
                "  ⚠ HTTP 404 — the content endpoint returned Not Found for this "
                "document.  The document may have been deleted, or the API base URL "
                "is incorrect.  Check the 'url' field in the 'Lucidchart' API "
                "Integration record (should be https://api.lucid.co)."
            )
        elif content_status == 0:
            content_hint = (
                "  ⚠ Network error — the content API could not be reached.  "
                "Check server connectivity to api.lucid.co and that the request "
                "does not time out."
            )
        elif content_status == 200:
            content_hint = (
                "  ⚠ HTTP 200 but no shapes found — the content API responded "
                "successfully but the page appears to have no shapes, or the shapes "
                "are in an unrecognised format.  The raw response structure is "
                "recorded in the Error Log (LuCrusher — Lucidchart content "
                "structure unrecognised)."
            )
        else:
            content_hint = (
                "  ⚠ HTTP " + str(content_status) + " from the content API — shape data is "
                "unavailable.  See the Error Log for the raw response."
            )

        for page in pages:
            lines.append("\n### Page: " + str(page["page_title"]))
            if page["shape_count"] == 0:
                lines.append(content_hint)
                lines.append("  Page confirmed in metadata: " + str(page["page_title"]))
                continue
            lines.append(
                "  Shapes: " + str(page["shape_count"]) + "  |  Connections: " + str(page["line_count"])
            )
            if page["swimlanes"]:
                lane_names = [s["text"] for s in page["swimlanes"] if s["text"]]
                if lane_names:
                    lines.append("  Swimlanes/Roles: " + ", ".join(lane_names))
                else:
                    lines.append("  Swimlanes: " + str(len(page["swimlanes"])) + " (no labels)")
            if page["terminators"]:
                terms = [t["text"] for t in page["terminators"] if t["text"]]
                if terms:
                    lines.append("  Start/End events: " + ", ".join(terms))
            if page["process_steps"]:
                step_texts = [s["text"] for s in page["process_steps"] if s["text"]]
                if step_texts:
                    lines.append("  Process steps (" + str(len(step_texts)) + "):")
                    for t in step_texts[:15]:
                        lines.append("    • " + t)
                    if len(step_texts) > 15:
                        lines.append("    … and " + str(len(step_texts) - 15) + " more steps")
            if page["decisions"]:
                dec_texts = [d["text"] for d in page["decisions"] if d["text"]]
                if dec_texts:
                    lines.append("  Decision points (" + str(len(dec_texts)) + "):")
                    for t in dec_texts[:10]:
                        lines.append("    ◇ " + t)
            if page["annotations"]:
                ann_texts = [a["text"] for a in page["annotations"] if a["text"]]
                if ann_texts:
                    lines.append("  Text annotations / instructions (" + str(len(ann_texts)) + "):")
                    for t in ann_texts[:5]:
                        lines.append("    ✎ " + t)
            if page["connections"]:
                labelled = [c for c in page["connections"] if c["label"]]
                if labelled:
                    lines.append("  Labelled connections (" + str(len(labelled)) + "):")
                    for c in labelled[:10]:
                        lines.append("    → " + str(c["label"]))
        return "\n".join(lines)

    # ── 1. Document id ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    document_id = _parse_document_id(document_id_or_url)
    if not document_id:
        return _fail(
            None,
            "Could not extract a Lucidchart document ID from: " + repr(document_id_or_url)
            + ". Please provide a valid Lucidchart share link or document UUID.",
        )

    # ── 2. Credentials ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    api_key, base_url, extra_headers = _credentials()
    if not api_key:
        return _fail(
            document_id,
            "Lucidchart API key is not configured. Please create an API Integration "
            "record named 'Lucidchart' with the API key in the 'API Key' field and "
            "'Is Active' checked.",
        )
    auth_headers = _auth_headers(api_key, extra_headers)

    # ── 3. Metadata ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    doc_title = ""
    api_pages = []
    page_count = 0
    try:
        meta = frappe.integrations.utils.make_get_request(
            base_url + "/documents/" + document_id, headers=auth_headers
        )
        if not isinstance(meta, dict):
            meta = {}
        doc_title = meta.get("title") or meta.get("name") or ""
        # The metadata endpoint returns pageCount; some versions also embed pages.
        page_count = meta.get("pageCount") or 0
        api_pages = meta.get("pages") or []
    except Exception as exc:
        # The gate forbids importing requests, so the failed response is read
        # back off frappe.flags rather than off a typed exception. status 0 =
        # nothing came back (timeout / unreachable host).
        resp = frappe.flags.integration_request
        status = resp.status_code if resp is not None else 0
        if status == 401:
            return _fail(
                document_id,
                "Lucidchart API returned 401 Unauthorized. The API key in the "
                "'Lucidchart' API Integration record is invalid, missing, or does not "
                "have the required scope. Please check the API key value in the "
                "'API Key' field of that record and ensure the record is marked as Active.",
            )
        if status == 403:
            return _fail(document_id, _lucrusher_share_hint(frappe, base_url, auth_headers))
        if status == 404:
            return _fail(
                document_id,
                "Document '" + document_id + "' was not found on Lucidchart. "
                "Please verify the document ID or URL.",
            )
        frappe.log_error(
            title="LuCrusher — Lucidchart metadata fetch error",
            message="document_id=" + repr(document_id) + "\nHTTP " + str(status) + "\n" + frappe.get_traceback(),
        )
        if not status:
            return _fail(
                document_id,
                "Cannot reach the Lucidchart API — the request timed out or the host is "
                "unreachable. Please check network connectivity to api.lucid.co and try again.",
            )
        return _fail(document_id, "Failed to fetch document metadata (HTTP " + str(status) + "): " + str(exc))

    # ── 4. Content ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    parsed_pages = []
    content_data, content_status = _fetch_content(document_id, base_url, auth_headers)
    if content_data:
        raw_pages = (
            content_data.get("pages")
            or content_data.get("document", {}).get("pages")
            or content_data.get("content", {}).get("pages")
            or (content_data.get("lucidchart") or {}).get("pages")
            or []
        )
        if raw_pages:
            parsed_pages = [_summarise_page(p) for p in raw_pages]
        else:
            frappe.log_error(
                title="LuCrusher — Lucidchart content structure unrecognised",
                message=(
                    "document_id=" + repr(document_id) + "\n"
                    + "Top-level keys: " + str(list(content_data.keys())) + "\n"
                    + "Full response (first 2000 chars): " + str(content_data)[:2000]
                ),
            )

    # Page stubs when the content endpoint gave us nothing.
    if not parsed_pages:
        if api_pages:
            stub_source = api_pages
        elif page_count:
            stub_source = [{"id": "page-" + str(i + 1), "title": "Page " + str(i + 1)} for i in range(page_count)]
        else:
            stub_source = []
        i = 0
        for p in stub_source:
            i += 1
            parsed_pages.append({
                "page_id": p.get("id") or p.get("pageId") or "",
                "page_title": p.get("title") or p.get("name") or ("Page " + str(i)),
                "shape_count": 0,
                "line_count": 0,
                "swimlanes": [],
                "process_steps": [],
                "decisions": [],
                "terminators": [],
                "annotations": [],
                "connections": [],
                "raw_shapes": [],
            })

    total_shapes = sum([p["shape_count"] for p in parsed_pages])
    total_lines = sum([p["line_count"] for p in parsed_pages])

    return {
        "document_id": document_id,
        "title": doc_title,
        "pages": parsed_pages,
        "page_count": len(parsed_pages),
        "total_shapes": total_shapes,
        "total_lines": total_lines,
        "summary": _build_summary(doc_title, document_id, parsed_pages, content_status),
        "content_api_status": content_status,
        "error": None,
    }


def _lucrusher_share_hint(frappe, base_url, headers):
    email = ""
    try:
        profile = frappe.integrations.utils.make_get_request(base_url + "/v1/users/me/profile", headers=headers)
        email = (profile or {}).get("email") or ""
    except Exception:
        frappe.log_error(title="LuCrusher - Lucidchart profile lookup", message=frappe.get_traceback())
    who = ("the Lucid account " + email) if email else "the Lucid account that owns the platform API key"
    return (
        "Lucidchart API returned 403 Forbidden: the document is not shared with the account behind the "
        "platform API key. Share it with " + who + " (Share, then add that email as Viewer or higher), "
        "wait a minute, then tell me to retry."
    )


def _lucrusher_trim_document(doc):
    # A 375-shape × 50-page parse is >100 kB of JSON. Give the model enough to
    # write a useful narrative and keep the full parse server-side.
    if not doc or doc.get("error"):
        return doc
    _MAX_LLM_PAGES = 5
    all_pages = doc.get("pages") or []
    trimmed_pages = []
    for page in all_pages[:_MAX_LLM_PAGES]:
        steps = [{"text": s.get("text", "")} for s in (page.get("process_steps") or [])[:8] if s.get("text")]
        decisions = [{"text": s.get("text", "")} for s in (page.get("decisions") or [])[:5] if s.get("text")]
        conns = [
            {"from": c.get("from", ""), "to": c.get("to", ""), "label": c.get("label", "")}
            for c in (page.get("connections") or [])[:8]
        ]
        annotations = [{"text": s.get("text", "")} for s in (page.get("annotations") or [])[:4] if s.get("text")]
        swimlanes = [{"text": s.get("text", "")} for s in (page.get("swimlanes") or []) if s.get("text")]
        terminators = [{"text": s.get("text", "")} for s in (page.get("terminators") or []) if s.get("text")]
        tp = {
            "page_title": page.get("page_title", ""),
            "shape_count": page.get("shape_count", 0),
            "line_count": page.get("line_count", 0),
            "swimlanes": swimlanes,
            "terminators": terminators,
            "process_steps": steps,
            "decisions": decisions,
            "connections": conns,
            "annotations": annotations,
        }
        for key, limit in (("process_steps", 8), ("decisions", 5), ("connections", 8)):
            original_count = len(page.get(key) or [])
            if original_count > limit:
                tp[key + "_truncated"] = True
                tp[key + "_total"] = original_count
        trimmed_pages.append(tp)

    remaining = len(all_pages) - _MAX_LLM_PAGES
    summary = doc.get("summary") or ""
    if remaining > 0:
        extra = []
        idx = _MAX_LLM_PAGES
        for p in all_pages[_MAX_LLM_PAGES:]:
            idx += 1
            extra.append((p.get("page_title") or ("Page " + str(idx))) + " (" + str(p.get("shape_count", 0)) + " shapes)")
        summary += (
            "\n\nNote: " + str(remaining) + " additional page(s) not shown in detail: "
            + ", ".join(extra[:20])
            + ((" … and " + str(remaining - 20) + " more") if remaining > 20 else "")
            + ". The full document data is preserved server-side."
        )
    return {
        "document_id": doc.get("document_id"),
        "title": doc.get("title"),
        "page_count": doc.get("page_count") or len(all_pages),
        "total_shapes": doc.get("total_shapes"),
        "total_lines": doc.get("total_lines"),
        "content_api_status": doc.get("content_api_status"),
        "summary": summary.strip(),
        "pages": trimmed_pages,
        "error": doc.get("error"),
    }


def _lucrusher_seen_marker(doc):
    # What a repeat request gets instead of the body: enough to recognise the
    # document and to ask for one page of it. finalize has the full parse.
    pages = []
    idx = 0
    for p in (doc.get("pages") or []):
        idx += 1
        pages.append({
            "page": idx,
            "title": p.get("page_title") or ("Page " + str(idx)),
            "shape_count": p.get("shape_count", 0),
        })
    return {
        "document_id": doc.get("document_id"),
        "title": doc.get("title"),
        "page_count": doc.get("page_count") or len(pages),
        "total_shapes": doc.get("total_shapes"),
        "total_lines": doc.get("total_lines"),
        "already_fetched": True,
        "pages": pages,
        "note": (
            "This document was already fetched earlier in this conversation; its full "
            "parse is kept server-side and finalize delivers it, so do not fetch it again "
            "to answer. To read one page in detail call this tool with "
            "'<document_id>#page=<n>'. Append '#refresh' only if the document has changed "
            "in Lucidchart since."
        ),
    }


def _lucrusher_page_detail(doc, page_no):
    # One page, untrimmed apart from the raw shape dump the model never needs.
    pages = doc.get("pages") or []
    if page_no < 1 or page_no > len(pages):
        return {
            "document_id": doc.get("document_id"),
            "title": doc.get("title"),
            "error": "Page " + str(page_no) + " does not exist; the document has " + str(len(pages)) + " page(s).",
        }
    page = dict(pages[page_no - 1])
    page.pop("raw_shapes", None)
    return {
        "document_id": doc.get("document_id"),
        "title": doc.get("title"),
        "page": page_no,
        "page_count": len(pages),
        "detail": page,
    }


# ── Fetched once per conversation ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Every turn is a fresh run, so the parse never outlived the turn that paid for
# it. It is kept in the conversation's session state under the document id; a
# repeat request gets the marker above, "#page=<n>" one page in detail, and
# "#refresh" a new fetch. The turn store still gets the full parse on every
# path, so finalize and the frontend see exactly what they saw before.
from one_bpmn.ai_agent_conversations import session_state as _lcr_state
import re as _lcr_re

_lcr_input = (task_data.get("document_id_or_url") or "").strip()
_lcr_page = None
_lcr_refresh = False
_lcr_suffix = _lcr_re.search(r"#(?:page=(\d+)|(refresh))\s*$", _lcr_input, _lcr_re.IGNORECASE)
if _lcr_suffix:
    _lcr_input = _lcr_input[:_lcr_suffix.start()].rstrip()
    if _lcr_suffix.group(1):
        _lcr_page = int(_lcr_suffix.group(1))
    else:
        _lcr_refresh = True

_lcr_id = _lcr_re.search(
    r"[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}", _lcr_input, _lcr_re.IGNORECASE
)
_lcr_key = ("lucid_doc:" + _lcr_id.group(0).lower()) if _lcr_id else None

_lcr_full = None
if _lcr_key and not _lcr_refresh:
    _lcr_full = _lcr_state.get_value(context_docname, _lcr_key)
_lcr_hit = isinstance(_lcr_full, dict) and not _lcr_full.get("error")

if not _lcr_hit:
    _lcr_full = _lucrusher_fetch_lucidchart(frappe, _lcr_input)
    if _lcr_key and not _lcr_full.get("error"):
        _lcr_state.record(context_docname, {_lcr_key: _lcr_full})

update_turn(context_docname, full_document=_lcr_full)
if _lcr_page and not _lcr_full.get("error"):
    result["document"] = _lucrusher_page_detail(_lcr_full, _lcr_page)
elif _lcr_hit:
    result["document"] = _lucrusher_seen_marker(_lcr_full)
else:
    result["document"] = _lucrusher_trim_document(_lcr_full)

# Lumina – Build Context
# Rebuild the history the agent sees. chat_history_limit lives on the agent
# configuration (a constant), so the window is configuration, not code.
import json
import re

conversation_id = task_data.get("conversation_id", context_docname)

# What this conversation has already established, read back rather than
# re-derived from the transcript. Rendered here rather than by a Python helper:
# how an agent presents its own scratchpad to its own model is behaviour, and
# behaviour belongs in the map.
from one_bpmn.ai_agent_conversations.session_state import get_state
session_state = get_state(conversation_id)
result["session_state"] = session_state
result["session_state_block"] = (
    "Established so far in this conversation:\n" + json.dumps(session_state, indent=2, default=str)
) if session_state else ""

user_text = task_data.get("user_text", "") or ""

_limit = 10
_cfg = frappe.db.get_value(
    "AI Agent Configuration", {"agent_id": "lumina_general_chat", "enabled": 1}, "name"
)
if _cfg:
    _row = frappe.db.get_value(
        "AI Agent Constant",
        {"parent": _cfg, "constant_name": "chat_history_limit"},
        "constant_value",
    )
    if _row:
        try:
            _limit = int(_row)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            _limit = 10


def _strip_html(text):
    # Bleach linkifies and tags the stored text; the model should read plain prose.
    if not text:
        return ""
    clean = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
    for entity, char in (
        ("&", "&"), ("<", "<"), (">", ">"),
        (""", '"'), ("'", "'"), (" ", " "),
    ):
        clean = clean.replace(entity, char)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", clean).strip()


messages = frappe.get_all(
    "Chat Message",
    filters={"conversation": conversation_id, "message_type": ["in", ["User", "Bot"]]},
    fields=["text", "message_type"],
    order_by="creation desc",
    limit=_limit,
)
messages.reverse()
chat_history = []
for m in messages:
    if not m.text:
        continue
    chat_history.append({
        "role": "user" if m.message_type == "User" else "assistant",
        "content": _strip_html(m.text),
    })

result["chat_history"] = chat_history
result["history_block"] = ""
result["user_text"] = _strip_html(user_text)
# The Tools gateway is decorative — the AI Agent Task runs its own tool loop.
result["needs_tools"] = False

server_scripts.script:
# Saves the agent response as a Bot Chat Message, reading the structured result
# the AI Agent Task's finalize tool wrote to the per-turn scratch store.
import json
conversation_id = task_data.get("conversation_id", context_docname)
from one_bpmn.agents.turn_state import get_turn, clear_turn
_turn = get_turn(conversation_id)
_out = _turn.get("output") if isinstance(_turn, dict) else None

# The agent's own final text (aiOutputVariable 'ai_result') — used when the agent
# answered without reaching a terminal tool, so we never discard its actual reply
# for a generic message.
_agent_text = task_data.get("ai_result")
if isinstance(_agent_text, dict):
    _agent_text = _agent_text.get("response") or _agent_text.get("text") or ""
if not isinstance(_agent_text, str):
    _agent_text = ""
_agent_text = _agent_text.strip()

_failed = task_data.get("run_prosally_agent_error_code")
if _failed:
    _reason = str(task_data.get("run_prosally_agent_error_message") or _failed).strip().rstrip(".")
    from one_bpmn.api.server_script_api import turn_failure_text
    _agent_text = turn_failure_text(_failed, _reason)
    _out = {"intent": "ERROR", "response": _agent_text}
if isinstance(_out, dict) and _out:
    response_text = _out.get("response") or _agent_text or "Could you tell me a bit more about the process you want to model?"
    intent = _out.get("intent")
    agent_result = _out
else:
    response_text = (task_data.get("response_text") or _agent_text
                     or "Could you tell me a bit more about the process you want to model?")
    intent = task_data.get("intent")
    agent_result = task_data.get("agent_result")
from one_bpmn.agents.prosally_helpers import add_document_sources
response_text = add_document_sources(response_text, intent, _turn)
if isinstance(agent_result, dict) and agent_result.get("response"):
    agent_result["response"] = response_text
msg = frappe.new_doc("Chat Message")
msg.conversation = conversation_id
msg.sender = "Administrator"
msg.receiver = "User"
msg.text = response_text
msg.message_type = "Bot"
_meta = {"intent": intent}
if isinstance(_turn, dict) and _turn.get("tool_error"):
    _meta["tool_error"] = _turn["tool_error"]
if isinstance(agent_result, dict) and agent_result:
    _meta["agent_result"] = agent_result
msg.metadata = json.dumps(_meta, default=str)
msg.insert()
result["bot_message_name"] = msg.name
